blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — Police arrested a 30-year-old man and seized about P510,000 worth of suspected shabu during a buy-bust operation in Polomolok, South Cotabato on Friday, Oct. 2. The Police Regional Office 12 (PRO-12) said the operation was carried out at around 11:09 a.m. at a waiting shed along the national highway in Barangay Silway 8. The suspect, identified only by his alias “Jat-jat,” a resident of Barangay Tambler in General Santos City, was classified by police as a high-value individual. Police said operatives recovered six sachets containing about 75 grams of suspected shabu, with an estimated street value of P510,000. […]...
